harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured node1 as the internal NTP time source (chrony, local stratum 10, allow 10.100.87.0/24) and node2 as a client synchronizing exclusively against node1 (chrony server 10.100.87.10 iburst, no public pools). Verified sync end-to-end, then restarted node1 and node2 one at a time (preserving the other's availability), confirming boot-identity change and full chrony recovery/re-sync after each restart.
actions_performed: Installed chrony on node1 and node2 (Ubuntu 24.04 ships only systemd-timesyncd, which is client-only)
systemd-timesyncd was removed/superseded automatically by the chrony install on both nodes
Confirmed node1 has no real external internet/NTP reachability, so configured it as a standalone authoritative source instead of depending on public pools
On node1: removed default pool ntp.ubuntu.com lines from /etc/chrony/chrony.conf, added 'local stratum 10' and 'allow 10.100.87.0/24', restarted chrony
On node2: removed default pool lines, added 'server 10.100.87.10 iburst', restarted chrony
Verified node2 selected node1 as its synced source (chronyc sources shows ^* against Reference ID 0A64570A = 10.100.87.10) and node1 shows node2 as a connected NTP client via chronyc clients
Captured pre-restart boot_id and chrony health baseline on both nodes
Restarted node1 via sudo reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id, verified chrony active and local-stratum config intact
Confirmed node2 (which stayed up throughout node1's restart) continued tracking node1 without config loss
Restarted node2 via sudo reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id, verified chrony active, config intact, and re-synced to node1 as source (^* Reference ID 0A64570A, stratum 11)

evidence.requirement: node1 configured as internal time source (own reference clock, serving node2)
evidence.summary: chrony.conf on node1 set to local stratum 10 with allow 10.100.87.0/24; chronyc tracking shows Reference ID 7F7F0101 (self) stratum 10; chronyc clients shows node2 (vm-rhel8-4189848754) polling it

evidence.requirement: node2 configured to sync against node1 instead of a public time server
evidence.summary: chrony.conf on node2 has only 'server 10.100.87.10 iburst', no pool lines; chronyc sources shows ^* selected source with Reference ID 0A64570A = 10.100.87.10 (node1), stratum 11

evidence.requirement: node1 pre-restart healthy baseline (boot identity, chrony health)
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id dfeb3b70-bc1e-4ce9-90d0-9c9c853416e7 and chrony active/tracking stratum 10 before restart

evidence.requirement: node1 restart acknowledgement and disconnection
evidence.summary: Backgrounded 'sudo reboot' returned acknowledgement before disconnect; subsequent poll timed out confirming node1 was down

evidence.requirement: node1 changed boot identity after restart
evidence.summary: boot_id changed to 19f1bc96-6b73-430b-8cc0-1f3f3ec842ad, proving an actual reboot occurred

evidence.requirement: node1 post-restart recovery of required service/config
evidence.summary: chrony active again, chronyc tracking shows Reference ID 7F7F0101 stratum 10, and chrony.conf still contains 'local stratum 10' / 'allow 10.100.87.0/24'

evidence.requirement: node2 pre-restart healthy baseline (boot identity, chrony health, synced to node1)
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id bdd5de93-e94e-4d33-8384-6a01c51a3d49; chronyc sources/tracking confirmed still synced to node1 after node1's own restart

evidence.requirement: node2 restart acknowledgement and disconnection
evidence.summary: Backgrounded 'sudo reboot' returned acknowledgement before disconnect; subsequent poll timed out confirming node2 was down

evidence.requirement: node2 changed boot identity after restart
evidence.summary: boot_id changed to 79870bec-3386-488d-82be-60c74822fadf, proving an actual reboot occurred

evidence.requirement: node2 post-restart recovery and re-sync to node1
evidence.summary: chrony active, chronyc sources shows ^* selected source Reference ID 0A64570A (node1) stratum 11, and chrony.conf still contains 'server 10.100.87.10 iburst' with no public pool entries
